info.title: Photo Diary API
info.description: Self-hosted photo-diary backend. Schema is generated from TypeBox-validated route handlers.

accessCookie.name: pd_access
accessCookie.description: Short-lived JWT in an HttpOnly cookie, set by login, refresh and SSO consumption. A request without it runs as the guest user. A request carrying an invalid or expired one is refused with 401 on every endpoint that documents a 401, including those a guest may read: call POST /api/v1/tokens/refresh, then retry once.

refreshCookie.name: pd_refresh
refreshCookie.description: Long-lived opaque session handle in an HttpOnly cookie. Rotated on every refresh; presenting a handle that was already rotated away revokes the session.
